extracted.intended_audience: scholars and students of classical mechanics; readers of Newton's Principia (Latin); mathematicians and physicists interested in geometric treatments of motion
extracted.subtask_description: A sequence of geometric propositions, problems, and corollaries concerning motion under centripetal forces: rectilinear descent/ascent, velocities proportional to areas, orbital trajectories (ellipses, hyperbolas, parabolas), and construction/invention of orbits and apsidal motion.
